gloss: arms and armor; weapons and military equipment

definitions.gloss: arms and armor; weapons and military equipment
definitions.explanation: A collective term covering weapons, armor, and other military equipment, especially from the samurai era. Includes both offensive items (swords, spears) and defensive items (armor, helmets).

examples.japanese: ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{武具|ぶぐ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Arms and armor are displayed at the museum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{武具|ぶぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怠|おこた}らなかった→怠る：03936_okotaru⟧。
examples.english: Samurai never neglected the maintenance of their arms and armor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦国時代|せんごくじだい}→戦国時代：19200_sengokujidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧や{槍|やり}、{弓矢|ゆみや}⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{武具|ぶぐ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戦|いくさ}→戦：28574_ikusa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}われた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: During the Warring States period, various arms such as swords, spears, and bows and arrows were used in battle.

notes:
A collective term for weapons, armor, and other military equipment, especially from the samurai era. Encompasses both offensive items (⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧, {槍|やり}, ⟦{弓|ゆみ}→弓：08430_yumi⟧) and defensive items (⟦{鎧|よろい}→鎧：14541_yoroi⟧, ⟦{兜|かぶと}→兜：11625_kabuto⟧, ⟦{盾|たて}→盾：03430_tate⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {武具|ぶぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to don arms and armor
- {武具|ぶぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧: maintenance of arms
- {武具|ぶぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to display arms and armor
- {武具|ぶぐ}⟦{甲冑|かっちゅう}→甲冑：15370_kacchuu⟧: arms and armor (emphatic)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{武器|ぶき}→武器：03605_buki⟧: weapon — specifically offensive weapons, not armor; more general and modern
- ⟦{兵器|へいき}→兵器：11679_heiki⟧: arms, ordnance — modern military weapons and equipment
- ⟦{甲冑|かっちゅう}→甲冑：15370_kacchuu⟧: armor (helmet and body armor) — specifically the defensive gear
